item.title: DigiCoinLib 0.0.3: A stronger foundation for DigiByte Wallet
item.description: A new open-source DigiByte library update improves compatibility with modern Android tooling, corrects test-network handling and strengthens automated tests while preserving standard mainnet wallet behavior.

item.title: DigiByte Wallet 0.1.5 is coming soon: What to expect
item.description: A preview of DigiByte Wallet 0.1.5: refreshed security dependencies, iPhone keychain and startup reliability improvements, more accessible text layouts and less disruptive ad placement.
